opentelemetry.blind_label_rationale: The upgrade changed custom telemetry attribute names from app.* to demo.* across services and broke existing dashboards/queries. A diagnostically relevant observation must therefore inspect raw telemetry identity/attributes rather than only the downstream dashboard.

oneuptime_v11.blind_label_rationale: v11 rebuilt telemetry storage, renamed serviceId/serviceType to primaryEntityId/primaryEntityType, and automatically migrated dashboards/monitors/alerts. A diagnostic observation should therefore inspect telemetry table/schema migration or migrated query state rather than only the monitor result.

confluence_audit.blind_label_rationale: Advanced Audit Log introduced an explicit upgrade task migrating legacy audit data into a new audit-log format/table. A diagnostic observation should therefore inspect audit format or migration state rather than only the downstream audit view.

gcp_datafusion_v3.blind_label_rationale: Google Cloud documents that InstanceV2 monitoring assets must migrate to InstanceV3 by changing resource type, metric paths, and removing labels absent from InstanceV3. Diagnostic observations should therefore inspect resource/metric schema mapping or migrated query state rather than only the downstream dashboard result.
